$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

root.$why: Select Item: Figma reserves the check mark's 16 px in the right padding (32 px) when the item is not selected; the code keeps an empty 16 px slot instead. Select Content: the menu's 1 px border is an inset shadow.

Check.$why: Figma's icon frame is 17.3 px; the code draws the same glyph (72 % of the 24 px grid) in a 16 px slot.

items.$why: The items slot is the menu's content box; the pixels cover it.
